name: DockMon
description: DockMon is a comprehensive, self-hosted Docker container monitoring and management platform. Monitor local and remote containers in real time with customizable dashboard widgets, intelligent auto-restart logic, multi-channel alerting (Discord, Slack, Telegram, Pushover, Gotify, SMTP), multi-container live log viewing, Compose stack management, and automatic container image updates. Key Features: - Multi-Host Monitoring: Monitor containers across unlimited local and remote Docker hosts with a lightweight Go agent. - Real-Time Dashboard & Stats: Drag-and-drop customizable widgets with WebSocket-streamed CPU, memory, and network metrics. - Intelligent Auto-Restart: Per-container auto-restart policy with exponential backoff and retry tracking. - Multi-Channel Alerting: Real-time alerts to Discord, Slack, Telegram, Pushover, Gotify, or Email with customizable alert rules and blackout windows. - Stack Management: Create, edit, and deploy Docker Compose stacks with image pull progress. - Automatic Updates: Schedule automatic image updates or trigger one-click updates with webhooks. - Multi-User & SSO/OIDC: Group-based RBAC with custom groups, granular permissions, and OIDC single sign-on (Authentik, Keycloak, Okta, Authelia). Initial Setup: 1. Open the WebUI at https:// :[PORT:443]/ after starting the container (accept the self-signed SSL certificate). 2. Create your administrator account on the initial setup screen. Local Docker socket access is pre-configured. Credits & Support: - DockMon is created by darthnorse ( GitHub ). Support the developer at Buy Me a Coffee . - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Storage path for DockMon database, settings, SSL certificates, and stack configurations.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Host Docker socket required for managing and monitoring local containers.

paths.name: Host /proc (System Metrics)
paths.description: Read-only mount of host /proc for accurate local CPU, memory, and IP detection.

paths.name: Host Root (Disk Metrics)
paths.description: Read-only mount of host root filesystem for disk space monitoring and low-disk alerts.

ports.name: WebUI Port (HTTPS)
ports.description: The WebUI port for DockMon (internal port is 443 HTTPS).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for the container (e.g. Europe/Amsterdam, America/New_York, UTC).

variables.name: External URL
variables.description: Optional public URL (e.g. https://dockmon.yourdomain.com) included in alerts for one-click action buttons.

variables.name: CORS Origins
variables.description: Allowed CORS origins if accessing DockMon behind a reverse proxy (e.g. https://dockmon.yourdomain.com).

variables.name: Base Path
variables.description: Subpath if running behind a reverse proxy subfolder (e.g. /dockmon/).

variables.name: Force Local Login
variables.description: Emergency recovery flag: set to 'true' to force local login if SSO/OIDC misconfiguration locks you out.
